chunks: Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
"The charities of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and the charities of Ali عليه السلام are permissible for Banu Hashim."

key_terms.رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, whose charities are mentioned as permissible
key_terms.صَدَقَاتِ: charitable properties or charities being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام, whose charities are likewise mentioned
key_terms.لِبَنِي هَاشِمٍ: for Banu Hashim, the clan of Hashim from the Prophet's family line

ai.seo_question: Which charities are permissible for Banu Hashim according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the charities specifically belonging to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and to Ali عليه السلام are lawful for Banu Hashim. It relates to financial law and clarifies an exception concerning the permissibility of certain forms of charity for the Prophet's clan.
